decisions.reason: Further-reading list item at cp 5922 (Spawls, Field Guide to East African Reptiles) begins a line '*' outside any <ref>. Ambiguous: 3.4 reads either as 'list item that itself contains a citation template or DOI/PMID' or, grammatically closer to the wording ('outside any <ref> that contains ...'), as 'list item outside any <ref> that contains such a template'. Under the second reading (the one the wording follows most closely, since 'that contains' attaches to <ref>) it is a bibliography entry. Under the first it would be out (only {{ISBN}}). The guide also says not to drop items when unsure. Locked label kept; ambiguity recorded for the owner. Note the same reading would bring the Editions list items of en-1361411235 into scope, which are not labelled there (not relabelled here).
Further-reading list item at cp 6241 (Tilbury and Branch, African Herp News), same reading and same ambiguity as item 0. Locked label kept.

{{NRDB species|genus=Polemon|species=christyi|accessdate=25 February 2019}} at cp 1399 renders as a database citation with an access date ('... Reptile Database. Accessed 25 February 2019.'). Its purpose is to format a citation, so it is a citation template under 'and similar', consistent with the Fishbase decision for en-1296237338. Ambiguous (name lacks Cite/Citation). Locked label stands.
